_doc: Vendored from cad-fork fixtures/golden/tolerances.json (brief I3): the platforms block, unchanged. The fork must not import from the control repo at runtime, so the policy is copied; re-copy it when I3 recalibrates. The invariance check uses rel_tol for volume, area, centre of mass and bounding box (relative to the shape's bounding-box diagonal powers) and dev_* for sampled point-to-surface deviation.
